Despite its name, Intriobang only has two constituent members.
Big Spherely was initially planned to be Fingun, a humanoid doing finger guns.
Pewpew is the only Altermon whose evolutionary line is based on separate forms of one Pokémon.
Like the other Eiveelutions, the Gun ones are based on field moves. Illveon is based on Sweet Scent. It used to be a Leafeon alter.
Braceon is based on Strength.
Beasteon is based on Softboiled. Before the version-exclusive Eiveelutions, it wasn't used for space reasons.
